about: The collections of library.promptugal.news. A collection is a shelf: its prefix starts every call number on it.

collections.title: Web Summit Lisbon 2026
collections.scope: Everything we found about Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (9 to 12 November 2026): the official replays by day and the talks in them by timestamp, standalone recordings, the organiser's own statements (Day Two cancelled by Storm Charles), speaker-side write-ups, PrompTugal.news's own coverage, and what is missing.
